evidence: Adds `getMemoryLoad()` to `src/interfaces/mining.h` and `src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp`, and updates template lifetime management during IPC client shutdown.
rationale: Improves completeness of the mining IPC interface and handles safe cleanup when an external client disconnects during node shutdown. While it touches capnp definitions and IPC disconnect lifetime handling, the core motivation and design center on block template memory accounting.
